note: Curated one-line descriptions for seeded roots whose cards do not yield a clean opening sentence.

summaries.google/madlad400-3b-mt: MADLAD-400-3B-MT is a multilingual machine translation model based on T5, trained on 1 trillion tokens across more than 450 languages.
summaries.google/madlad400-10b-mt: MADLAD-400-10B-MT is a multilingual machine translation model based on T5, trained on 250 billion tokens across more than 400 languages.
summaries.Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini: Zyphra's compact open text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning and word-level control, fast enough to run in real time on a phone.
summaries.inworld/voice-isolator: Apache-2.0 48 kHz voice isolation for noisy recordings and live audio: the cleaned voice and the removed background come out as two aligned tracks.
summaries.inworld/sava: Apache-2.0 semantic acoustic voice-activity detection that also marks end-of-turn, for streaming speech pipelines on recorded or live audio.
summaries.FluidVoice-Labs/fluid-speech-pro: FluidVoice's 0.6B speech-to-text model for noisy rooms: about 600 MB on device, with GGUF, MLX, ONNX, and CoreML builds.
summaries.Reson8/Rumble-2-Flash: An open 0.5B speech-recognition model covering 40+ languages, built for on-device transcription.
summaries.meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B: Meta's 816B-parameter open-weight Muse Spark model with 42B active parameters, plus an NVFP4 build.
summaries.meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B: Meta's 30B open-weight multimodal model, with an assistant tune and GGUF builds.
summaries.SupersonicLabs/Julia-1: Supersonic Labs' first decision model: it takes a state and a typed question, then returns a decision for software to act on.
summaries.SupersonicLabs/Julia-1.5: The rule-following update to Julia 1 at the same size, scoring 46.2 on Supersonic's SLCMB benchmark against 33.3 for Julia 1.
summaries.SupersonicLabs/Julia-2: A decision model that reads text, JSON, images, and live audio and returns a decision in milliseconds.
summaries.SupersonicLabs/Julia-2-Flash: The 658 MB version of Julia 2, down from 2.14 GB, with the same inputs and API and within 0.1 points on the held-out decision test.
summaries.SupersonicLabs/Julia-2-Nano: The microcontroller build of Julia 2: 15 MB of weights, runs in C, with ESP32-S3 firmware for text decisions.
summaries.RadixArk/DaisyRose-27B: RadixArk's 27B multimodal model for visual analysis, planning, and tool use, built on a Qwen base.
summaries.ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview: Ricursive AI's 65B dense model with a 1M-token context, pretrained on 12 trillion tokens and tuned for agentic coding.
summaries.Motif-Technologies/Motif-3: Motif Technologies' MIT-licensed reasoning model for multi-step problem solving and tool use.
